Composed with field — the dialog owns the frame, not the form grammar.

Rule 10 — anything portalled has to re-enter the scope

The theme is a .raqt class and custom properties inherit down the DOM. A dialog that portals to document.body lands outside the scope and picks up the host app's palette instead. Re-establish it inside the portal on a display:contents wrapper — <div className="contents raqt"> — and carry the mode explicitly, because the portal left its ancestry behind: a light-mode host needs "raqt light". dialog does this already; copy it rather than rediscovering it.
